IRSA archive (NASA/IPAC)
SPHEREx level 2 images, release DR1 (spherex_dr1)
102 bands, 0.75 to 5.0 um, six detector arrays D1 to D6

span.p:
Public S3 bucket nasa-irsa-spherex
the same FITS files
HTTP range requests allowed

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SIMBAD (CDS)
position and proper motion
only the target name is sent

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p: resolve: target name to its position at the observing time

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
SIA2 cone search, 0.02 degree circle
one row per image: obs_id, t_min, detector, FITS URL

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Range-read one 117 px region of IMAGE, VARIANCE and WCS-WAVE
about 2 MB per image, never the whole 65 MB file

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Align every frame to one sky grid
drop edge cutouts under 80% covered
